Governo.titolo: Riunione sull'Ucraina del "Formato di Berlino" e incontro con il Presidente Zelensky

L'incontro è stata l’occasione per riaffermare il pieno sostegno all'Ucraina, anche alla luce dei recenti colloqui trilaterali di Abu Dhabi.

Governo.titolo: Riunione della Coalizione europea contro le droghe
Governo.descrizione: A margine del Vertice della Comunità politica europea di Dublino, il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, e il Presidente della Repubblica francese, Emmanuel Macron, hanno presieduto una nuova riunione dei leader della Coalizione europea contro le droghe (ECAD), iniziativa promossa congiuntamente da Italia e Francia.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission publishes technical guidance to support implementation of the Digital Product Passport Registry
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: A complete set of technical documentation is now available to help organisations prepare their systems for the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) Registry.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Electricity Coordination Group considers EU electricity market prepared for the winter
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU electricity market is suitably prepared for the winter, but it is necessary to continue monitoring the market closely, according to discussions between the European Commission, national experts and key stakeholders in the Electricity Coordination Group (ECG) meeting that took place yesterday.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission unconditionally approves UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has unconditionally approved, under the EU Merger Regulation, the proposed acquisition by UniCredit of Commerzbank. The Commission concluded that the transaction would raise no competition concerns in the European Economic Area (‘EEA').

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Joint press statement by Michael McGrath, Commissioner for Democracy, Justice, the Rule of Law and Consumer Protection and Immaculate Kassait, Data Commissioner of Kenya
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU and Kenya advance towards a landmark mutual data adequacy arrangement, paving the way for safe data flows, stronger digital trade, research cooperation and investment opportunities - the first such EU-Africa partnership.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ten citizen-led energy communities win the first EU Prize for Governance Innovations in Energy Communities
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission awarded the first Prize for Governance Innovations in Energy Communities. The prize recognises renewable and citizen energy communities that stand out for how they make decisions, share benefits and work with local authorities and businesses.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission assesses Poland’s 2030 National Energy and Climate Plan, welcomes its ambition and encourages full implementation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission today published its assessment of Poland’s final updated National Energy and Climate Plan (NECP), acknowledging Poland’s increased ambition compared to its draft plan

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission restricts lead in fishing weights and lures to protect people and the environment
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 12 November 2026, the Commission adopted measures to restrict lead in fishing weights and lures under the EU’s chemicals legislation, REACH.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: President von der Leyen and Commissioner Kos to host second EU Enlargement Forum
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On Monday, President of European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, together with Commissioner for Enlargement Marta Kos will host in Brussels the second EU Enlargement Forum, entitled 'Wider Europe - Stronger Europe'.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU actions improving access to climate finance
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: As the world’s largest climate finance provider, the European Union (EU) is committed to making international climate finance easier to access, especially for the poorest and most vulnerable countries.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Three new ERC Scientific Council members and two new vice-presidents
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has appointed today three new members and renewed five current members of the ERC Scientific Council. The Scientific Council has also elected two of its new vice-presidents.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €286 million German State aid to port of Hamburg
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, two €143 million German measures to support infrastructure works in the port of Hamburg. The measures concern two distinct infrastructure projects, one at the Salzgitter quay and one at the Steinwerder quay.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste generated in 2024
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In 2024, 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste were generated in the EU. Household disposal accounted for over half of this amount. During the same year, 1.4 million tonnes of textile waste were treated, corresponding to 63% of all textile waste generated that year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Value of agriculture output hits record high in 2025
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In 2025, the value of EU agricultural output reached a record €558.7 billion in basic prices, up 4.8% from €532.9 billion in 2024.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union and the Global Green Growth Institute today signed a €10 million contribution agreement for the Global Gateway Climate Investment Facility designed to help partner countries translate climate commitments into investment-ready projects and mobilise public and private finance.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Experts from the Commission, EU countries, the International Energy Agency (IEA), the Energy Community and NATO met again today in the Oil Coordination Group to take stock, together with industry representatives, of the current oil market situation.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The defence landscape is constantly evolving and requires constant innovation. New technologies are mandatory to keep the armed forces of the EU member states always ahead.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission helped to bring together more than 5,000 representatives from Ukrainian and international businesses, government institutions, financial organisations and international partners at the EU-Ukraine Investment Conference, held during the ReBuild Ukraine Expo in Warsaw.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has decided to close its preliminary antitrust probe into allegedly anticompetitive behaviour by the Dutch State-owned rail incumbent Nederlandse Spoorwegen (‘NS').

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Join EAfA’s webinar on integrating basic skills in apprenticeships

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Pact for Skills and the European Alliance for Apprenticeships (EAfA) are hosting a Knowledge Exchange Event on cooperation in EU cross-border regions. The webinar will take place on 17 November 2026 from 11:00–12:30 CET

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Agreement reached on 2027 fishing opportunities for the Baltic Sea
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Council of the European Union reached a political agreement on the fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea for 2027, following the Commission proposal made in August this year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission seeks feedback on limited assurance standards for sustainability reporting
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The consultation invites feedback on the Committee of European Auditing Oversight Bodies’ (CEAOB) technical advice, as well as on their proposed adjustments to the international standard.
